bug_1_alert_card_navigation.fix_description: Alert card onClick now navigates to /alerts when activeAlerts.length === 0, instead of doing nothing
bug_1_alert_card_navigation.code_snippet: onClick={() => activeAlerts.length > 0 ? router.push({ pathname: '/alert-detail' as any, params: { alertId: activeAlerts[0].id } }) : router.push('/alerts' as any)}
bug_1_alert_card_navigation.verification: Code correctly implements ternary: if alerts exist -> /alert-detail with alertId, else -> /alerts

bug_2_library_dropdown_in_header.fix_description: LibraryFilterDropdown is now rendered in the header section (dark background area) when tab === 'library', not in the white content area
bug_2_library_dropdown_in_header.code_location: Inside the header div (lines 230-305), after the PILL TABS and BEN SELECTOR sections
